en: A black and white group photograph showing a large number of men and women, many in military or paramilitary uniforms, posed in front of a weathered wooden building. Several men hold musical instruments, and there is a prominent flag with visible text. The women in the front row are dressed in period-appropriate dresses, some in folk-style garments. In the bottom right, the text 'Fot. Brūkus' is visible, suggesting the photographer.
